snippets.title: Aaron Levie on agents and product
snippets.takeaway: Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”. The form factor of a product like Muse is you want to be able to hand off a task to the agent...
snippets.summary: Aaron Levie (levie on X) shared 1 recent update. Personal agents are the ultimate manifestation of “build something that agents want”. The form factor of a product like Muse is you want to be able to hand off a task to the agent and ensure that it is fully completed end to end. To do this, the agent must be able to successfully operate with your tools or use its own to complete the task. Use your MCP or CLI, easily navigate your site, be able to transact, and more.
